acceptedAnswer.text: In older Fort Worth homes, precise interior door installation often requires accounting for uneven door frames and settled foundations. AKN Design Group leverages our decades of experience and local DFW expertise to address these challenges effectively. Our skilled craftsmen conduct meticulous measurements and make necessary adjustments during installation to ensure that new doors fit perfectly, operate smoothly, and maintain their aesthetic appeal. This attention to detail is part of our commitment to craftsmanship and reliability, ensuring that even in historic properties, our renovations enhance functionality and beauty.
